name: Butter Chicken
description: Tender chicken simmered in a silky tomato-butter gravy, finished with cream and warm spices. Served with steamed basmati rice.

name: Caesar Salad
description: Crisp romaine, shaved parmesan, toasted croutons and a house Caesar dressing. Light, bright, and ready quickly.

name: Lamb Shank
description: Slow-braised lamb shank with rosemary jus, root vegetables, and a potato puree. A signature in-room dining classic.

name: Club Sandwich
description: Triple-stack toasted sandwich with grilled chicken, smoked bacon, lettuce, tomato, and herb mayonnaise.

name: Penne Pasta
description: A classic Italian delight with perfectly cooked penne tossed in a rich and creamy sauce, complemented by fresh herbs and parmesan cheese for an indulgent experience.

name: Margherita Pizza
description: Wood-fired pizza with San Marzano tomato, fresh mozzarella, basil, and extra-virgin olive oil.

name: Tomato Bisque
description: Velvety roasted tomato bisque with basil oil and a warm mini focaccia on the side.

name: Grilled Salmon
description: Atlantic salmon grilled to medium, lemon-caper butter, seasonal greens, and herb potatoes.
